*** Add File: stream_platform_generation.py
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, Iterator, Optional, Tuple
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _client() -> OpenAI:
+    return OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def stream_platform_generation(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini",
+    system: Optional[str] = None,
+    extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+) -> Iterator[Tuple[Any, Any]]:
+    client = _client()
+    messages = []
+    if system is not None:
+        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system})
+    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
+    stream = client.responses.stream(model=model, input=messages, **(extra or {}))
+    with stream as response_stream:
+        for event in response_stream:
+            yield event, response_stream
+
+
+def collect_stream_text(prompt: str, *, model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini") -> str:
+    chunks = []
+    for event, _response in stream_platform_generation(prompt, model=model):
+        text = getattr(event, "delta", None)
+        if isinstance(text, str):
+            chunks.append(text)
+        else:
+            item = getattr(event, "output_text", None)
+            if isinstance(item, str):
+                chunks.append(item)
+    return "".join(chunks)
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PlatformResource:
+    provider: str
+    resource_type: str
+    resource_id: str
+    model: str
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    return value if value not in (None, "") else default
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    deployment: Optional[str] = None,
+    inference_profile: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> PlatformResource:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=_env("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    candidate = model or deployment or inference_profile or _env("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+    resolved = candidate.strip() if candidate else "gpt-4o-mini"
+    if deployment:
+        resource_type = "deployment"
+        resource_id = deployment.strip()
+    elif inference_profile:
+        resource_type = "inference_profile"
+        resource_id = inference_profile.strip()
+    else:
+        resource_type = "model"
+        resource_id = resolved
+    _ = client
+    return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource_type=resource_type, resource_id=resource_id, model=resolved)

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from anthropic import Anthropic
+
+
+def invoke_platform_model(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: str = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
+    max_tokens: int = 1024,
+    system: Optional[str] = None,
+    temperature: Optional[float] = None,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    deployment_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    inference_profile_id: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])
+    metadata: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    if project_id is not None:
+        metadata["project_id"] = project_id
+    if deployment_id is not None:
+        metadata["deployment_id"] = deployment_id
+    if inference_profile_id is not None:
+        metadata["inference_profile_id"] = inference_profile_id
+
+    params: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": model,
+        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+    }
+    if system is not None:
+        params["system"] = system
+    if temperature is not None:
+        params["temperature"] = temperature
+    if metadata:
+        params["metadata"] = metadata
+
+    response = client.messages.create(**params)
+    content = "".join(block.text for block in response.content if hasattr(block, "text"))
+    return {
+        "content": content,
+        "model": response.model,
+        "id": response.id,
+        "usage": {
+            "input_tokens": response.usage.input_tokens,
+            "output_tokens": response.usage.output_tokens,
+        },
+    }
*** End Patch
